builds.name: The Pale Horse
builds.desc:
Yes, L'Arachel has poor health and Def, but on a Calvary emblem team, she will demolish. With anyone on your team using Hone Calvary in combo with Ivaldi's built in Atk/Spd +3 and this build's Atk/Spd +5, that adds up to a total Atk/Spd +14. This bumps her neutral stats up into the > 50/40 range, a tough feat for most blue units.
Renewal 3 places her back into 100% health range to utilize Atk/Spd Push 3 two turns back to back. A backup would be Chill Atk 3 to pad everyone's survivability.
The combo Atk Smoke 3 and Spd Smoke 3 helps everyone else on the team increase their chance for doubles and take less damage after her first massively overpowered attack. Toss Gunnthra on this team and she'll do an extra 14-26 damage per attack, too.
